name: @celestia/pyxis
description: Pyxis — a PixiJS renderer on @celestia/jupiter. The SECOND web client (after Phaethon/Phaser), proving the SDK is renderer-agnostic: it imports only @celestia/jupiter + pixi.js, zero transport/netcode. Pyxis = the Mariner's Compass constellation; the name echoes 'Pixi' the way Phaethon echoes 'Phaser'.
